sqlquery.from:
(SELECT iv.id,st.code, cl.name as clientname,iv.exchangeRate,iv.number,iv.invoicedate,iv.duedate,iv.discount,cu.name as currencyname, st.name as statusname,(ad.address||', '||ad.city||', '||co.name||', '||ad.zipcode) as billingaddress,iv.ponumber,shm.name as shippingmethod,iv.subtotal,iv.totaltaxes, iv.totaldiscount, case when iv.iscreditnote = true then iv.total*(-1) else iv.total end as total, iv.totalininvoicecurrency,bna.accountnumber as accountnumber,acc.name as accountname FROM "$".saleinvoice sliv INNER JOIN "$".invoice iv ON iv.id = sliv.id LEFT JOIN "$".invoiceitem ivit ON ivit.invoice_id = iv.id LEFT JOIN "$".item it ON it.id = ivit.item_id LEFT JOIN currency cu ON cu.id = iv.currency_id LEFT JOIN "reference" st ON st.id = iv.status_id LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount cl on cl.id = sliv.client_id LEFT JOIN "$".address ad on cl.billingaddressid = ad.id LEFT JOIN "public".country co ON co.id = ad.countryid LEFT JOIN "$".shippingmethod shm ON shm.id = sliv.shippingmethodid LEFT JOIN "$".bankaccount bna ON bna.id = sliv.bankaccountid LEFT JOIN "$".account acc ON acc.id = bna.accountid
where iv.deleted is not true group by iv.id,st.code,cl.name,iv.exchangeRate,iv.number,iv.invoicedate,iv.duedate,iv.total,iv.discount,cu.name,st.name,ad.address, ad.city,co.name,ad.zipcode,iv.ponumber,shm.name,iv.subtotal,iv.totaltaxes,iv.totaldiscount,iv.total,iv.totalininvoicecurrency,bna.accountnumber,acc.name,cl.deleted,iv.iscreditnote order by iv.id desc) t

terms.value: t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.code!='REVERSED'
